Non-existent calendar dates (e.g. 2025-04-31) are excluded; they are\n    #    not part of the employee's cumulative salary_amount sequence.\n    ts = ts.assign(dt=pd.to_datetime(ts[\"date\"], errors=\"coerce\", format=\"%Y-%m-%d\"))\n    ts = ts[ts[\"dt\"].notna()].copy()\n\n    # 4. Hours: must be a non-negative number.\n    ts[\"hours\"] = pd.to_numeric(ts[\"hours_worked\"], errors=\"coerce\")\n    ts = ts[ts[\"hours\"].notna() & (ts[\"hours\"] >= 0)]\n\n    # 5. timedelta(days=1)\n            start = first_weekday(prev.year, prev.month)\n        return start\n\n    ts[\"period\"] = ts[\"dt\"].apply(period_start)\n    ts[\"rate\"] = ts[\"employee_id\"].map(rates)\n    ts[\"pay\"] = ts[\"hours\"] * ts[\"rate\"] + ts[\"task_bonus\"]\n\n    # Employees must show up on the billing day to collect their salary.\n    attendance = set(zip(ts[\"employee_id\"], ts[\"dt\"].dt.date))\n\n    totals = ts.groupby([\"employee_id\", \"period\"])[\"pay\"].sum().reset_index()\n    totals = totals.sort_values([\"employee_id\", \"period\"])\n\n    result: dict[str, list[int]] = {}\n    for pesel, group in totals.groupby(\"employee_id\", sort=True):\n        salaries = [\n            _round_half_up(pay)\n            for period, pay in zip(group[\"period\"], group[\"pay\"])\n            if (pesel, period) in attendance\n        ]\n        if salaries:\n            result[pesel] = salaries\n    return result\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n    with open(\"/app/answer.json\", \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(answer(), f, default=list)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":869,"cache_read_input_tokens":60563,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":869,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"098ad62d-3286-4b9c-95c6-01761996d7c4","uuid":"22c0ce88-5e0b-402a-bb86-4c08c5312ce3","timestamp":"2026-10-20T08:31:00.018Z"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgDBE4AAsNJkfHF4VAvzP","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've written `/app/answer.py` and run it, which produced `/app/answer.json`.
